name: Chicken Pesto Pasta Bake

components.name: Chicken Pesto Pasta Bake
steps: Heat oven to 200 C. Bring a pot of water to the boil and cook penne one minute less than the packet recommendation; drain.
In a skillet, heat 15 ml olive oil and cook diced chicken until lightly golden, then transfer to a clean bowl.
Sauté diced onion and garlic briefly in the same pan. Add stock and bring to a simmer; return chicken and ensure it is fully cooked to 74 C.
Turn heat off, then stir in yogurt, cottage cheese, pesto, lemon and seasonings to avoid splitting dairy.
Combine with drained pasta and transfer to a casserole dish. Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 15-20 minutes until the topping has melted and the centre is hot; rest, divide into five containers and chill promptly.

Freezer: published source recommends freezer storage
Dietary: Contains dairy, wheat, pine nuts may be present in pesto.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
